name: NavigationLinks
description: The NavigationLinks component provides a sophisticated navigation system with smooth transitions, dropdown submenus, active state tracking, and theme toggle integration.
usage: Interactive highlight pill that follows the active/hovered link
Automatic active state tracking based on current path
Dynamically calculates submenu positioning based on parent link
Only activates hover effects on devices that support hover
Uses CSS variables for submenu dimensions to enable smooth transitions
Handles navigation between submenus with smooth animations
Provides visual feedback for active/current sections
Features intelligent mouse interaction handling to prevent accidental submenu closing

props.name: navigationItems
props.description: Array of navigation items to display. Each item can include label, href, icon, external link flag, and optional submenus.

props.name: showThemeToggle
props.description: Whether to show the theme toggle button

props.name: showThemeColorButton
props.description: Whether to show the theme color button

props.name: themeComponent
props.description: Which theme component to display (toggle or switcher)

props.name: onLinkClick
props.description: Callback when a link is clicked

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container
